card.name: Word right after a first adjective or adverb
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, and, comma) or verbs that come right after a first adjective or adverb in a pair or list, like 'anatomic or' or 'emotionally and'. The next word is expected to be a parallel adjective or adverb.

modes.label: Joining paired adjectives
modes.description: 'or', 'and' or a comma after a first adjective, before a second matching one.
modes.example: Most, but not all, of these patients had underlying anatomic<< or>> vascular risk factors for development of NAION

modes.label: Partway through list-like words
modes.description: Inside a word or after a short term that starts a parallel series.
modes.example: Politically, milit<<arily>>, and in terms of international law,

modes.label: Verb after a subject noun
modes.description: A verb following a short subject phrase, before a complement.
modes.example: The method of drug delivery<< makes>> accidental or intentional overdosage unlikely.

card.plain: It fires on the little word after the first of two matching descriptive words, like 'symptomatic and' before 'supportive'.
